purpose: Confirmed operational blockers for the three Creator HQ channels. GitHub workflow sends private Telegram notification once when a NEW confirmed/open blocker is committed.

policy.notifyIf: A production/publication/dependency has actually stopped or is blocked; proven by recent provider data, authenticated live check or direct provider confirmation, with explicit next action.
neverNotifyFor: Editorial goals that are not booked
An unverified platform state or old saved snapshot
Normal review/processing less than the provider's normal processing window
Known old issues listed in incidents until confirmed as a NEW operational blocker
policy.repeat: Only if a resolved issue reopens or notificationRevision explicitly increases. Editing unrelated files or commentary must not send duplicates.
policy.sendMode: GitHub Actions push of THIS file through existing Creator HQ private Telegram bot. Push notifications also depend on user's Telegram notification settings.
policy.noGuarantee: Monitoring depends on scheduled checks and provider access; a stale snapshot never proves a live failure.
